finding.claim: Unauthenticated insecure deserialization: attacker-supplied base64 `state` parameter is passed to Marshal.load, allowing arbitrary object instantiation and gadget-chain remote code execution.
finding.source: POST /restore form/query parameter params[:state] (attacker-controlled, no authentication)

trace.note: Base64.decode64(params[:state]) yields attacker bytes, passed directly to Marshal.load
state.inspect invoked on the deserialized object (can also trigger attacker-defined methods)

finding.guards_checked: No authentication, signature/HMAC, class allowlist, or size limit on the path. Marshal.load has no safe mode. Sinatra has no global auth by default and the file defines no before filters.

verdict.reason: app.rb:5-6 shows the unauthenticated POST /restore route passing Base64.decode64(params[:state]) straight into Marshal.load. app.rb is the only file in the directory, so there are no before filters, auth, HMAC or class allowlist, and state.inspect at app.rb:7 runs on the deserialized object.
